title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java / Spring Boot)
description: We are building the transaction core of a regional payments platform. You will own services that settle money movement between banks, which means correctness, idempotency and observability matter more here than feature velocity. The team is six engineers; there is no separate ops team, so whoever writes a service also runs it. Expect to spend real time on schema design, on failure modes that only appear under concurrency, and on explaining your reasoning in design review. The stack is Java 21 and Spring Boot on PostgreSQL, deployed to Kubernetes, with Kafka between services.

requirements.text: 5 or more years writing production backend services in Java
Production Spring Boot experience covering dependency injection, transaction boundaries and Spring Data JPA
Relational data modelling and SQL on PostgreSQL or a comparable engine, including indexing and reading query plans
Writes automated tests at both unit and integration level
Has designed and versioned REST APIs consumed by other teams
Kafka or another log-based message broker
Distributed tracing or comparable production observability tooling
Has operated and been on call for services they wrote
Experience with financial or otherwise correctness-critical systems
